description: Versioned STT benchmark corpus definition. Audio is generated locally by New-SttCorpus.ps1 (Windows SAPI synthesis + programmatic noise/gain mixing); only this manifest and the scripts are committed, never the WAV output. Reference transcripts are the literal text handed to the synthesizer. Cases whose required SAPI voice language is not installed are generated as pending (never fabricated).

categories.natural-english: Plain English sentences at conversational length.
categories.short-phrases: One-to-three word utterances; stresses VAD minimum-speech endpointing.
categories.filenames-paths: File names, extensions, and Windows paths spoken naturally.
categories.commands: Shell and tool commands as spoken by a developer.
categories.numbers: Cardinal, decimal, and date-like number speech.
categories.punctuation: Punctuation names spoken aloud; also checks that natural prosody punctuation survives segment joins.
categories.noise: Same reference sentence mixed with white noise at a defined SNR (dB).
categories.quiet-microphone: Natural sentence attenuated to simulate a quiet input level.
categories.auto-language: Non-English utterances run with language auto-detect; requires a matching installed SAPI voice.
categories.accent: English with non-US voices; only generated when such a SAPI voice is installed, otherwise pending.
categories.long-form: Multi-sentence dictation around one minute; stresses segmentation, state growth, and stop-to-text latency.

Here is the plan for the release. First, we freeze the preview surface and route every annotation through the capture pipeline. Second, the recorder gains a microphone track and a system audio track, both opt in. Third, dictation keeps Parakeet as the default local engine, with Whisper as the explicit fallback and no silent cloud path. The benchmark corpus measures cold start, warm start, real time factor, and word error rate for every category we can synthesize honestly. Rows that need a real microphone or a human speaker stay pending instead of being fabricated. Finally, the copy honesty gate keeps the beta wording until the acceptance evidence exists. If any step regresses, we stop and record the failure rather than shipping a hopeful maybe.
